# Vendored libraries

Local copies so the mock runs offline and in sandboxed environments.
Versions match the CDN builds named in `docs/frontend-development-instructions.md`.

| File | Package | Version |
| --- | --- | --- |
| bootstrap.min.css, bootstrap.bundle.min.js | bootstrap | 5.3.3 |
| jquery.min.js | jquery | 3.7.1 |
| stimulus.umd.js | @hotwired/stimulus | 3.2.2 |
| feather.min.js | feather-icons | 4.29.2 |

The Rails app uses its own copies; these are only for previewing the pages here.
